name: Jakarta International Stadium
scope: Standing Jakarta International Stadium in North Jakarta with the fixed low-pitch roof, open retractable panels, perforated stadium shell, three-tier football bowl, raised concourse and the immediate approach structures.
era: Completed stadium in the open-roof football configuration documented by the 17 November 2023 match photograph.

originalReview.notes: The seating tiers, concrete aisles, pitch architecture and open rectangular roof framed by steel trusses are visible. Incidental spectators, displays, ads and football-event content supply no model geometry or texture.

review.method: Exact published Qualla architectural photograph with original CC0 dedication
review.notes: Started on the Jakarta International Stadium Qualla story. Its cleared football photograph matches the signed native Commons CC0 original byte-for-byte. The other cleared candidate is a concert whose stage imagery is outside the architectural scope. Exterior color, shell and roof construction use mapped geometry and written facts from the architects, suppliers and sports authority.
